As soon as the wax seal physically detaches and falls to the ground, it is not replaced, duplicated, or regenerated at any point. Once the seal is removed, the envelope flap slowly lifts. From within, shimmering sparkles, glittering dust, and trails of radiant light emerge, spreading in a mesmerizing display to the surroundings, with magical beams of luminous particles curving around the envelope, passing in front of and behind it in a three-dimensional spiral.
